description: This file defines classes representing various DVB descriptors such as NetworkName, SatelliteDeliverySystem, CableDeliverySystem, and Service, including their methods and data members. It also includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: NetworkName
classes.description: Represents a network name descriptor with a method to retrieve the name string.

classes.name: SatelliteDeliverySystem
classes.description: Represents a satellite delivery system descriptor with methods to access frequency, modulation, symbol rate, and FEC inner.

classes.name: CableDeliverySystem
classes.description: Represents a cable delivery system descriptor with methods to access frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC inner, and FEC outer.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Represents a service descriptor with methods to access service type, provider, and name.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the network name as a string.

methods.name: Frequency
methods.description: Returns the frequency in KHz for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: Modulation
methods.description: Returns the modulation type for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: SymbolRate
methods.description: Returns the symbol rate for satellite or cable delivery systems.

methods.name: FECOuter
methods.description: Returns the outer FEC type for cable delivery systems.
